notes.title: HUGE DEMO UPDATE: Smarter Colonists, New UI, and Faster Controls!
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45423482/8284088d52465c0e064eae07d224244afb4afaa1.png"]
HUGE DEMO UPDATE! 

GAMEPLAY:
Smarter Everything: Mechs, Marsects, and Colonists have all gotten brain upgrades. They’re smarter now.   
UI:
Dome UI Overhaul: Click the Dome icon on the Dome (or use the left-hand Dome icons) to instantly bring up the Dome panel. Managing your colony just got smoother.

Dome Naming: You can now edit and personalize your Dome names! “Home Sweet Dome!”  

UI Windows: Click the X icon to close any window.  
CONTROLS:
Mech Commands: Right-click to command your Mechs to move (no longer left-click).  

Rapid Build: Hold Shift + Left-click to place the same thing multiple times, no need to reopen the panel.  

Faster Controls: Zooming in and out with your mouse wheel is now way faster. Navigate Mars like a pro. 



Try it out now and tell us what you think! Share your screenshots, Dome names, and chaos in ⁠Discord! 



And if you can, please show some love on our Kickstarter!

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/cyborgdreams/mars-the-last-exodus-when-colony-sim-meets-rts

notes.title: New Update on the Second Playtest!
notes.notes:
Hey Marsnauts, 



Great news, the playtest has been extended until Sunday, July 13th at 23:59 UTC!



That means more time to play, and we’d really appreciate it if you could share your thoughts in the feedback form in-game or in the #⁠feedback-form channel on Discord!



And a fun new feature just landed! When you hit “Recruit”, you can now customize your colonists' outfits! Side effect? Some of the colonists didn’t get the memo and showed up… without clothes. 



This is an early implementation of the "Recruit" customization. 

In the meantime, please enjoy this “Bare Essentials” Edition.
